repos.description: Agents that use the browser.
repos.summary_zh: Browser-Use 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的网页自动化框架，通过 LLM 驱动浏览器完成复杂在线任务。支持主流大模型（Gemini、Claude 等），提供 stealth 模式云浏览器服务，实现高效、隐蔽的网页交互与数据采集，适用于自动化测试、信息抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: Browser-Use is an AI agent framework that enables LLM-driven automation of web tasks. It supports major LLMs (Gemini, Claude, etc.) and offers stealth cloud browsers for secure, scalable automation. Ideal for web scraping, testing, and data collection with seamless integration.

repos.description: Playwright is a framework for Web Testing and Automation. It allows testing Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with a single API.
repos.summary_zh: Playwright 是一个现代化的 Web 测试与自动化框架，支持 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 三大浏览器内核的统一 API 调用。其核心优势在于内置智能等待机制、原生支持跨浏览器测试、无人工超时设计，以及自动生成测试追踪与录屏功能，显著提升端到端测试的稳定性与效率。
repos.summary_en: Playwright is a modern framework for web testing and automation that provides a single API to test Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit browsers. It features built-in auto-waiting, cross-browser support, no artificial timeouts, and native tracing/video capture, making end-to-end tests more reliable and efficient.

repos.description: Open-source web crawler and scraper for LLMs and AI agents: any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Run it yourself, or use Crawl4AI Cloud with one key.
repos.summary_zh: Crawl4AI 是一个开源的 LLM 友好型网络爬虫与抓取工具，专为将网页转换为干净、适合大语言模型（LLM）处理的 Markdown 格式而设计，广泛应用于 RAG、智能体和数据流水线场景。其核心亮点包括高吞吐量、可控性强、支持 Docker 部署，并具备崩溃恢复、预抓取加速等高级功能，拥有 5 万+ GitHub 星标社区。
repos.summary_en: Crawl4AI is an open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper that converts web pages into clean, LLM-ready Markdown for RAG, agents, and data pipelines. It features high throughput, Docker support, crash recovery, prefetch mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery, and is battle-tested by a 50k+ star community. Ideal for scalable, cost-effective web extraction.

repos.description: Independent technology for modern publishing, memberships, subscriptions and newsletters.
repos.summary_zh: Ghost 是一个现代化的开源 Node.js 内容管理系统（CMS），专为独立创作者、会员订阅和新闻通讯设计。它提供强大的发布工具、会员管理和订阅功能，支持无头架构，可灵活集成前端框架。核心优势包括简洁的编辑器、SEO 优化、自动化工作流和 Ghost(Pro) 托管服务，适合个人博客、媒体网站及内容变现平台。
repos.summary_en: Ghost is a modern, open-source Node.js CMS designed for professional publishing, memberships, subscriptions, and newsletters. It offers a clean editor, SEO tools, and headless architecture for flexible front-end integration. With features like automated workflows and Ghost(Pro) managed hosting, it's ideal for creators and publishers seeking a developer-friendly, scalable platform.

repos.description: Chrome DevTools for coding agents
repos.summary_zh: Chrome DevTools MCP 是一个专为 AI 编码代理（如 Gemini、Claude、Cursor 等）设计的 MCP 服务器，通过 Chrome DevTools 协议实现浏览器自动化、性能分析与深度调试。支持网络请求分析、截图、控制台日志追踪及性能追踪，结合 Puppeteer 实现可靠操作，适用于网页自动化与智能调试场景。
repos.summary_en: Chrome DevTools MCP is an MCP server enabling AI coding agents (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Cursor) to control and inspect a live Chrome browser via the Chrome DevTools Protocol. It provides advanced debugging, performance tracing, network analysis, and screenshot capabilities using Puppeteer for reliable automation, ideal for web automation and intelligent debugging.

repos.description: A visual no-code/code-free web crawler/spider易采集：一个可视化浏览器自动化测试/数据采集/网页爬虫软件，可以无代码图形化的设计和执行爬虫任务。别名：ServiceWrapper面向Web应用的智能化服务封装系统。
repos.summary_zh: 易采集/EasySpider 是一款完全免费的视觉无代码浏览器自动化工具，支持图形化设计爬虫任务，无需编程即可实现网页数据采集与自动化测试。通过可视化操作选择网页元素，自动识别同类内容并批量采集，同时支持命令行模式嵌入其他系统，适用于电商、数据抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: EasySpider is a completely free visual no-code web crawler and browser automation tool that enables users to design and execute data collection tasks through a graphical interface without programming. It automatically detects similar elements on web pages, supports batch data extraction, and can also run via command line for integration into other systems, ideal for e-commerce scraping and automation testing.

repos.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
repos.summary_zh: agent-browser 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的高效无头浏览器自动化 CLI 工具，基于原生 Rust 构建。它提供简洁的命令行接口，支持通过元素引用（refs）或传统选择器操作网页，实现点击、填充表单、截图等自动化任务，无需依赖 Playwright 或 Node.js，显著提升 AI 代理的网页交互能力。
repos.summary_en: agent-browser is a high-performance headless browser automation CLI tool designed for AI agents, built with native Rust. It offers an intuitive command-line interface to interact with web pages via element references or traditional selectors, enabling actions like clicking, filling forms, and taking screenshots without requiring Playwright or Node.js, significantly enhancing AI agent web interaction capabilities.

repos.description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一个通用 CLI 中枢与 AI 原生运行时，可将任意网站、Electron 应用或本地工具转换为标准化命令行接口。支持浏览器自动化、70+ 内置站点适配器（如 Bilibili、知乎等）、AI 智能体无缝集成，具备反检测机制与零 LLM 成本运行特性。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is a universal CLI hub and AI-native runtime that transforms websites, Electron apps, and local tools into deterministic command-line interfaces. It features browser automation, 70+ built-in site adapters (e.g., Bilibili, Zhihu), anti-detection measures, and seamless AI agent integration with zero LLM token consumption.

repos.description: JavaScript in-page GUI agent. Control web interfaces with natural language.
repos.summary_zh: Page Agent 是一个基于 JavaScript 的网页内 GUI 智能体，通过自然语言控制网页界面。无需浏览器扩展、Python 或无头浏览器，直接在页面中运行。支持文本化 DOM 操作、自定义 LLM、人机交互 UI，并提供 Chrome 扩展实现跨标签页任务。适用于 SaaS AI 助手、表单自动化、无障碍访问等场景。
repos.summary_en: Page Agent is a JavaScript-based in-page GUI agent that controls web interfaces via natural language. It runs directly in the browser without requiring extensions, Python, or headless browsers. Features text-driven DOM manipulation, customizable LLMs, human-in-the-loop UI, and optional Chrome extension for multi-tab workflows. Ideal for SaaS AI copilots, form automation, and accessibility tools.

repos.description: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
repos.summary_zh: Maxun 是一个开源无代码平台，专为实时网页抓取、爬取、搜索和 AI 数据提取设计，可将任意网站快速转换为结构化 API。支持录制操作、自然语言驱动提取、网页转 Markdown/HTML 及全站爬取，适用于构建自动化数据流水线，无需编程即可实现复杂的数据采集任务。
repos.summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code platform for real-time web scraping, crawling, search, and AI-powered data extraction. It transforms any website into a structured API in minutes, offering recorder mode, LLM-driven extraction, full-page scraping, and scalable crawling—ideal for building automated data pipelines without coding.

repos.description: The fastest browser for AI agents to run browser automation, built for sharing your logged-in browser state with your AI agents, like Codex or Claude Code, without disturbing you. Zero cost, zero config.
repos.summary_zh: ego-lite 是专为 AI 智能体设计的高速浏览器，支持用户与 AI 代理并行工作。AI 可在独立空间运行浏览器任务，同时共享用户的登录状态、Cookie 和扩展，零配置零成本，无缝集成 Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 助手。
repos.summary_en: ego-lite is a high-performance browser built for AI agents, enabling parallel work between users and AI assistants. Agents run browser tasks in isolated spaces while sharing your logins, cookies, and extensions with zero setup cost, seamlessly integrating with Claude Code, Codex, and other leading AI tools.

repos.description: Python version of the Playwright testing and automation library.
repos.summary_zh: Playwright-Python 是微软开源的跨平台浏览器自动化库，支持 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 三大内核。提供同步/异步 API，具备无头模式、自动等待、网络拦截等特性，适用于端到端测试、网页爬虫和自动化任务，性能可靠且支持多平台部署。
repos.summary_en: Playwright-Python is Microsoft's cross-browser automation library supporting Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. It offers sync/async APIs with features like headless mode, auto-waiting, and network interception, ideal for E2E testing, web scraping, and automation across platforms with high reliability and performance.

repos.description: Make Any Website & Tool Your CLI. A universal CLI Hub and AI-native runtime. Transform any website, Electron app, or local binary into a standardized command-line interface. Built for AI Agents to discover, learn, and execute tools seamlessly via a unified AGENT.md integration.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一个强大的 AI 原生浏览器自动化工具，可将任意网站或 Electron 应用转换为命令行接口。它支持会话复用、AI 驱动的发现与合成，提供零风险的数据提取和跨平台自动化能力，适用于 Bilibili、知乎、小红书等主流平台。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is a powerful, AI-native browser automation tool that turns any website or Electron app into a CLI. It enables seamless web data extraction and automation with session reuse, AI-powered discovery, and dynamic adapter loading, supporting platforms like Bilibili, Zhihu, and Xiaohongshu.

repos.description: A faster, simpler way to drive browsers supporting the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
repos.summary_zh: chromedp 是一个高效的 Go 语言库，用于通过 Chrome DevTools 协议驱动浏览器，无需外部依赖。它支持无头模式运行、页面截图、自动化操作等场景，适用于网页爬虫、自动化测试和数据采集。核心优势包括高性能、简洁 API 和跨平台兼容性。
repos.summary_en: chromedp is a high-performance Go library for driving browsers via the Chrome DevTools Protocol without external dependencies. It supports headless browsing, page screenshots, and automation tasks like web scraping and testing. Key features include fast execution, simple API, and cross-platform compatibility.

repos.description: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.
repos.summary_zh: Chrome MCP Server 是一款基于 Chrome 扩展的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，将浏览器功能暴露给 Claude 等 AI 助手，实现复杂浏览器自动化、内容分析与语义搜索。它直接利用用户现有 Chrome 环境，保留登录状态与配置，支持 20+ 工具，提供本地流式 HTTP 通信，并集成 SIMD 加速的向量数据库，实现智能跨标签页语义检索。
repos.summary_en: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex automation, content analysis, and semantic search. It leverages your existing Chrome browser with preserved login states and settings, supports 20+ tools, offers local streamable HTTP communication, and features SIMD-accelerated vector database for intelligent tab content discovery.

repos.description: ⚡️next-generation personal AI assistant powered by LLM, RAG and agent loops, supporting computer-use, browser-use and coding agent, demo: https://demo.openagentai.org
repos.summary_zh: OpenAgent 是一款开源的企业级 AI 知识库与智能体管理平台，支持 MCP/A2A 协议，集成 ChatGPT、Claude、Llama 等主流大模型，提供带单点登录的管理后台和用户界面，适用于构建私有化 AI 应用与多智能体协作系统。
repos.summary_en: OpenAgent is an open-source enterprise-grade AI knowledge base and agent management platform supporting MCP/A2A protocols. It integrates major LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, and Llama, offering admin UI, user management, and SSO for secure, scalable AI application deployment.

repos.description: Self-hosted webscraper.
repos.summary_zh: Scraperr 是一款强大的自托管网页爬虫解决方案，支持无代码配置、XPath精准提取、多任务队列管理、媒体下载及结果可视化导出，适用于数据采集与自动化分析场景。
repos.summary_en: Scraperr is a powerful self-hosted web scraping tool enabling code-free configuration, XPath-based extraction, queue management, media downloads, and structured data export, ideal for automated data collection and analysis.

repos.description: Chrome extension & CLI to let agents control your browser. Runs Playwright snippets in a stateful sandbox. Available as CLI or MCP
repos.summary_zh: Playwriter 是一款 Chrome 扩展工具，允许 AI 智能体通过 CLI 或 MCP 协议控制用户浏览器。它直接连接已登录的 Chrome 实例，保留用户会话状态（如 cookies、扩展），避免新建浏览器带来的安全风险和检测问题。核心功能包括 Playwright API 调用、多会话隔离、网络请求拦截、页面调试编辑等，适用于自动化测试、数据采集和智能体交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Playwriter is a Chrome extension enabling AI agents to control your browser via CLI or MCP. It connects directly to your running Chrome instance, preserving logins, extensions, and cookies—avoiding the security risks and detection issues of spawning new browsers. Key features include full Playwright API access, isolated sessions, network interception, page debugging, and live code editing for automation, testing, and agent-driven workflows.

repos.description: splinter - python test framework for web applications
repos.summary_zh: Splinter 是一个简洁易用的 Python Web 应用自动化测试框架，提供直观的 API 支持浏览器交互自动化。它基于 Selenium 构建，支持多浏览器驱动，具备快速开发、灵活扩展和真实场景适配能力，适用于 Web 测试、爬虫及自动化任务。
repos.summary_en: Splinter is a simple and consistent Python framework for automating web applications. Built on Selenium, it offers an intuitive API for browser automation, supporting multiple drivers and real-world use cases. Ideal for testing, scraping, and UI automation with robust and flexible capabilities.

repos.description: 🚀 A statistical analysis tool for performance testing
repos.summary_zh: Hiper 是一款专为性能测试设计的统计分析工具，支持通过 Chrome 浏览器自动化采集页面加载时间、DNS 查询、TCP 连接等关键性能指标，提供详细的统计报告与可视化分析，适用于 Web 性能监控与优化。
repos.summary_en: Hiper is a statistical analysis tool for performance testing that automates Chrome browser interactions to collect key metrics like DNS lookup, TCP connection, and page load times, delivering detailed reports and visualizations for web performance monitoring and optimization.

repos.description: A powerful no-code automation tool. Build workflows via drag-and-drop modules for web scraping, form filling and automated testing. | 一款功能强大的自动化工具，通过拖拽模块的方式快速构建自动化工作流，无需编写任何代码即可实现网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等任务。【QQ交流群：115069513】
repos.summary_zh: Web RPA 是一款强大的可视化网页自动化工具，支持零代码拖拽构建自动化工作流，涵盖网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等场景。基于 FastAPI + React 架构，集成 273 个功能模块，涵盖浏览器自动化、数据处理、数据库操作、媒体处理、PDF 转换、文档转换等全栈能力，提供智能搜索、Mermaid 流程图、变量自动补全等高效开发特性，支持非商业免费使用。
repos.summary_en: Web RPA is a powerful visual automation tool enabling zero-code workflow creation via drag-and-drop. It supports web scraping, form filling, and testing with 273 built-in modules across browser automation, data processing, database operations, media handling, PDF conversion, and document transformation. Built on FastAPI + React, it offers smart search, Mermaid flowcharts, variable autocompletion, and full non-commercial free usage.

repos.description: Flexible Node.js crawler library
repos.summary_zh: x-crawl 是一个灵活的 Node.js AI 辅助爬虫库，集成 Ollama 和 OpenAI，支持动态/静态页面、接口及文件数据抓取，具备设备指纹伪装、代理轮换、失败重试、优先级队列等功能，通过 AI 智能解析应对网页结构变更，提升爬虫效率与智能化水平。
repos.summary_en: x-crawl is a flexible Node.js AI-assisted crawler library integrating Ollama and OpenAI. It supports dynamic/static pages, API, and file data crawling with features like device fingerprinting, proxy rotation, retry mechanisms, and priority queues. AI-powered semantic parsing helps adapt to website structural changes, enhancing efficiency and intelligence.

repos.description: Let your AI agent get the sources behind logins and paywalls.
repos.summary_zh: Actionbook 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的浏览器操作引擎，提供实时更新的网页操作手册和 DOM 结构信息，使智能体能快速、精准地执行网页交互任务。相比传统方法，其性能提升 10 倍，显著降低 LLM 的 token 消耗，并通过语义化 JSON 定义实现高容错性和跨框架兼容性。
repos.summary_en: Actionbook is a browser action engine designed for AI agents, delivering up-to-date action manuals and DOM structure so agents can instantly operate any website without guessing. It enables 10x faster execution, 100x token savings, resilient automation via versioned manuals, and universal compatibility with any LLM or agent framework.

repos.description: Multi-service toolkit for Tavily and Firecrawl signup automation, key validation, and isolated proxy pools.
repos.summary_zh: 该工具专注于自动化注册和验证 Tavily、Firecrawl 及 Exa 的 API Key，支持多服务并发注册、邮箱验证码自动处理、真实接口可用性验证，并可选上传至统一代理池，为 MySearch-Proxy 提供稳定上游密钥源。
repos.summary_en: This toolkit automates registration and validation of API keys for Tavily, Firecrawl, and Exa. It supports concurrent signups, email verification handling, real-time API testing, and optional upload to a unified proxy pool, serving as a reliable upstream key provider for MySearch-Proxy.

repos.description: BrowserWing turns your browser actions into MCP commands Or Claude Skill, allowing AI agents to control browsers efficiently and reliably. Say goodbye to slow, token-heavy LLM interactions — let agents call commands directly for faster automation. Perfect for AI-driven tasks, browser automation, and boosting productivity.
repos.summary_zh: BrowserWing 是一款原生浏览器自动化平台，支持通过 MCP 协议和 Claude Skill 让 AI 智能体直接控制浏览器。提供 26+ HTTP API 接口、可视化脚本录制、LLM 驱动的数据提取及会话管理，实现高效可靠的浏览器自动化，显著减少 LLM 交互延迟。
repos.summary_en: BrowserWing is a native browser automation platform that enables AI agents to control browsers via MCP commands or Claude Skills. It offers 26+ HTTP APIs, visual script recording, LLM-powered data extraction, and session management for fast, reliable automation with minimal token overhead.

repos.description: Use opencli CLI to interact with social/content websites (Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube, Weibo, 小红书, V2EX, Reddit, HackerNews, 雪球, BOSS直聘 etc.)
repos.summary_zh: Qiaomu OpenCLI Skills 是基于 opencli 框架的 Claude Code 技能集合，支持79+网站和桌面应用的CLI化操作，涵盖B站、Twitter、知乎等主流平台的内容获取、发布、下载及浏览器自动化功能，具备智能搜索路由和适配器自动修复能力。
repos.summary_en: Qiaomu OpenCLI Skills is a collection of Claude Code skills built on the opencli framework, enabling CLI operations for 79+ websites and desktop apps. It supports content retrieval, publishing, downloading, and browser automation across platforms like Bilibili, Twitter, Zhihu, with intelligent search routing and auto-repair capabilities.

repos.description: Use opencli CLI to interact with social/content websites (Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube, Weibo, 小红书, V2EX, Reddit, HackerNews, 雪球, BOSS直聘 etc.)
repos.summary_zh: opencli-skill 是一个 Claude Code 技能，通过复用 Chrome 登录态直接操控 B站、知乎、Twitter/X、YouTube 等 16 大平台，支持内容浏览、搜索与发布，无需 API Key，实现自然语言驱动的跨平台自动化交互。
repos.summary_en: opencli-skill is a Claude Code skill that enables natural language control over 16 major platforms (e.g., Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube) by reusing your Chrome login sessions via opencli CLI—no API keys required—supporting reading, searching, and posting across social and content sites.

repos.description: berserkJS 是新形态的前端测试自动化工具 + 页面性能分析工具 ，同时也是个使用 JS 语法控制的命令行浏览器。可用 JS 编写前端自动测试用例 + 页面性能分析用例。 想了解更多？看看连接中的文档吧~~
repos.summary_zh: berserkJS 是一款基于 Qt 的前端自动化测试与页面性能分析工具，支持无头浏览器模式运行主流测试框架，提供 DOM 操作、网络监控、屏幕捕获及性能指标采集功能，API 简洁且符合 W3C 标准，已在微博、Cisco、腾讯等企业落地应用。
repos.summary_en: berserkJS is a Qt-based frontend automation and performance analysis tool that supports headless browser testing with mainstream frameworks, offering DOM manipulation, network monitoring, screenshot capture, and performance metrics collection. Its W3C-compliant APIs are simple and production-proven in enterprises like Sina Weibo, Cisco, and Tencent.

repos.description: A Markdown rendering engine that generates paginated PNG and SVG output — no browser, no Chromium, no DOM.
repos.summary_zh: marknative 是一个原生 Markdown 渲染引擎，无需浏览器或 DOM，直接生成分页的 PNG/SVG 文档。它通过自建排版引擎实现确定性分页和头less服务端渲染，支持 CommonMark + GFM 语法，适用于 API 文档、电子书等需要精确控制排版的场景。
repos.summary_en: marknative is a native Markdown rendering engine that generates paginated PNG/SVG output without requiring a browser, Chromium, or DOM. It parses Markdown into an internal document model, runs its own layout and pagination engine, and paints pages using Skia Canvas. Ideal for deterministic, server-side rendering of technical docs, e-books, and reports.

repos.description: Browser-Use Desktop app, control your local Chrome browser with AI agents!
repos.summary_zh: Browser-Use Desktop 是一款基于 Electron 和 Gradio 的桌面应用，通过 AI 智能体控制本地 Chrome 浏览器，实现网页自动化操作。支持多模态 LLM（如 OpenAI、Google、Anthropic 等）和自定义浏览器配置，无需重新登录网站，支持高清屏幕录制，适用于网页抓取、自动化测试等场景。
repos.summary_en: Browser-Use Desktop is an Electron-based desktop app that enables AI agents to control your local Chrome browser via Gradio UI. It supports multiple LLMs (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, etc.), custom browser profiles, and high-definition screen recording, eliminating re-authentication issues and ideal for web automation and scraping tasks.

repos.description: 一个基于 Nuxt.js 3 开发的小红书工具网站，提供图文，视频，评论 浏览与导出
